hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run --quiet python -m deeper_research.asta_config --quiet || true

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run --quiet pre-commit run mdformat --files $(ls docs/*.md outputs/*.md 2>/dev/null) >/dev/null; rc=$?; if [ $rc -gt 1 ]; then echo "mdformat (pre-commit) could not run: docs/ and outputs/ were not formatted (docs/tooling.md, Formatting)" >&2; exit 1; fi
